SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE 
    status = 'valid'
    AND (
        -- Cognitive score within acceptable range (> 6)
        cognitive_score > 6 
        AND cognitive_score <= 100

    AND (
        -- Reaction time within reasonable bounds (200 < ms < 1000)
        reaction_ms > 200 
        AND reaction_ms < 1000
    );", "summary": "Create cleaned measurements with outliers removed"}
